summary: Candidate B v3 is rejected: the mountain edit reintroduced perspective and repetition, and regenerated non-mountain details despite the single-change invariant.
required_changes: Return to B v2 and confine the next mountain edit to a binary mountain-footprint mask; reuse B v2 pixels exactly outside the mask and allow only top-down ridge and valley lines inside it.
